summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved lists not persisting  **No changes made.** I had an agent trace the full path (client → API → auth middleware → schema → handlers) and empirically reproduce the reported flow (signup → add card → logout → log back in) directly against the running backend. Result: the backend persisted correctly every time. The code as written does not have an obvious "missing WHERE clause" or "anonymous fallback" bug — ownership scoping, auth middleware, and cookie-based sessions all checked out in a clean repro.  That changes the shape of this ticket: it's not a q
